description:
Master Electrical Contracting.

Welcome to The 360 Electrician, the #1 resource for electricians ready to stop trading time for money and start building a profitable business.

Whether you are a solopreneur in a van or scaling a multi-crew fleet, this channel cuts through the noise to teach you the business side of the trade that trade school skipped.

What you'll learn here:
Bidding & Estimating: How to price jobs to actually make a profit.
Operations: Systems, field software, and hiring tips to reclaim your time.
Marketing: How to get the phone to ring with high-value clients.

I’m Jeff, a Master Electrician and Business Coach. I’ve made the mistakes so you don’t have to. Subscribe to turn your trade into an empire.

Want to go next level? - Check out our Skool page  at  www.Skool.com/the360businessacademy check it out

For Coaching & The Contractor Playbook visit us at www.The360Electrican.com and don't forget to check us out on IG and TikTok @the360electrician
